Nk'Abakristo bafite ubushobozi bw'ubuhanga kandi biyemeje, dukora buri munsi kugira ngo ducye amapfa y'umwuka mu migi yacu kandi dusubize imitima y'abantu benshi ku isi yose.
Youth Evangelical Fellowship (YEF) trace: Youth Evangelical Fellowship (YEF) ifite imizi yayo mu 2002, ubwo Apostolos Campus Ministry (ACM) yashingwaga na Dr. David Jang hamwe n'abanyeshuri ba Olivet Theological College and Seminary (OTCS). Mu 2003, umurimo watangiye gukura ugahinduka icyo wari kuzaba Youth Evangelical Fellowship, ugukomeza icyerekezo gikura cyo kugera ku banyeshuri ba kaminuza binyuze mu Ijambo ry'Imana, ubwigishwa, n'ivanjiri.
Youth Evangelical Fellowship headquarter: Inyubako y'Ikigo Nyamukuru cya Youth Evangelical Fellowship
Youth Evangelical Fellowship is a group: Youth Evangelical Fellowship ni itsinda ry'Abakristo bafite umwete kandi bagera ku bandi, ubwangavu n'ishyaka byabo bikoreshwa mu kuzana ubwiza ku izina ry'Imana. Dushaka kubona Ubutumire bukomeye bwa Yesu busohoye mu mugi wose ukomeye ku isi nk'uko yabyivugiye mu isengesho rye, “ubwami bwawe bubeho, ibyo ushaka bikorwe, ku isi nk'uko biri mu ijuru.” (Matayo 6:10) YEF yabaye ikimenyetso cy'ubugingo mu butumwa bw'imijyi kuva ishingwa, ikora kugira ngo icungure kampusi za kaminuza ku bw'impamvu ikomeye ya Yesu Kristo.
